summary: Full E2E validation of the new live-timing feature (backend + frontend). 7 new pytest cases for /api/admin/timing endpoints all pass. Playwright E2E through the /admin/timing page validated: nav from AdminDashboard, distance sections, live clock tick, two-click ARM → CONFIRM saving to /api/results, guard-before-start error toast, reset that preserves finish times, and inline edit/save/cancel/clear on the participants table. Results grouped and sorted ascending. All required data-testids present and functional.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /admin/timing endpoints correctly gated by get_current_user; state stored in db.timing keyed by distance. Clean.

LiveTiming.jsx: armed state is in-memory only (per-browser). If two funktionärer both arm the same bib on different devices, one confirm can overwrite; acceptable for MVP given single-operator use case, but worth documenting.
AdminDashboard.jsx: previously fixed old test credential in backend_test.py (was gustavsund@gmail.com) to admin/bergslagenadmin so regression suite runs green with current .env.
handleBibClick uses armed[bib] !== undefined which correctly distinguishes ARM from CONFIRM even when captured seconds==0.
seed_data_creation: None — used the 15 seeded runners (bibs 1-15). Cleaned up bib 1 finish_time at end of E2E run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend timing endpoints (GET /api/admin/timing, POST /admin/timing/start, /start-all, /reset) all authenticated + tested in /app/backend/tests/test_timing.py. Live timing UI at /admin/timing has data-testids: timing-section-6km|14km|47km, clock-6km|..., start-6km|..., start-all, reset-6km|..., bib-btn-<n>. Two-click flow: first click arms (adds bib to `armed` state map, shows 'Bekräfta?'), second click POSTs /admin/finish then clears armed. Inline edit in /admin table: edit-time-<bib> → edit-time-input-<bib> → save-time-<bib> / cancel-time-<bib> / clear-time-<bib>. Reset only clears the start clock, keeps saved finish_time. Time format accepts TT:MM:SS or MM:SS; normalized to HH:MM:SS on save.
